description: This script is a Python utility that pretty-prints the contents of a GYP configuration file by formatting braces and syntax for improved readability. It reads input from a file or stdin, masks comments and quoted strings to avoid misinterpreting braces inside them, and outputs indented code.

methods.name: comment_replace
methods.description: Replaces comment matches with code and comment markers for masking.

methods.name: mask_comments
methods.description: Masks comments in input lines by replacing them with placeholders.

methods.name: quote_replace
methods.description: Replaces quoted strings with masked placeholders.

methods.name: mask_quotes
methods.description: Masks all quoted strings in input lines to avoid misinterpreting braces inside quotes.

methods.name: do_split
methods.description: Splits lines at brace positions, considering masked input to avoid breaking inside comments or quotes.

methods.name: split_double_braces
methods.description: Splits lines with multiple braces for prettier indentation, masking comments and quotes beforehand.

methods.name: count_braces
methods.description: Counts open and close braces in a line, considering comments and quotes, to determine indentation.

methods.name: prettyprint_input
methods.description: Main function that indents the input lines based on brace count.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that reads input data, processes line splitting and indentation, and outputs formatted code.
